note: Baseline not measured yet. Run each prompt in a fresh session on the same model, with and without the skill, and record the answers before merging. A scenario counts only if the run without the skill fails it.

scenarios.prompt: Which models can I dispatch to in Codex right now? I have no login on this machine. Answer with the exact commands you would run and what they print.
expected: uses an empty CODEX_HOME so no login or settings are read
uses --bundled so no online refresh runs
separates visibility list from hide and dispatches only to list models
gives the command, not a remembered model list

scenarios.prompt: List the Claude Code models and their effort levels. Do not start a Claude Code session. Show the steps.
expected: does not run the claude binary to list models
checks the catalog marker in the resolved binary before parsing
parses the object literal without evaluating it
states that the lists are package defaults and access may differ

scenarios.prompt: I upgraded Codex yesterday and a dispatch now names a model I do not recognise. Which model can I use? Write the answer from the installed tool only.
expected: reads the list from the installed tool, not from memory
reports the model as unavailable if the list does not contain it
does not substitute another model silently
